_comment: Which build each manual documents, and where to find it running.
`ref` is the branch a capture session is expected to be on. It is checked
before anything is shot, because the alternative has already happened once:
a figure was captured from a dev server left running on an unmerged feature
branch, and documented a sign-in screen that does not exist in the product.
Nothing about the image showed it.
As of writing, three of these four repos have a feature branch checked out,
so `npm run shoot` will refuse until somebody checks out the documented ref.
That refusal is the feature. `ALLOW_REF_DRIFT=1` overrides it and the drift
is written into every provenance file it produces, so a figure taken off-ref
`url` can be overridden per app with the named environment variable, because
dev servers move: these apps pick the next free port, and the port that
served the customer app one afternoon served the corporate portal the next.

caretaker-mobile-app-live.note: Expo dev client against the local backend — needs Metro on 8081 with EXPO_PUBLIC_API_PORT matching the API. The static-demo build cannot document signing in, because it opens already signed in.
